title: PFPTok-Experiments: code for the PFPTok experiments
description: Code to reproduce the experiments in Testagrose, Varki and Boucher, "PFPTok enables efficient long-context genomic sequence modeling" (Genome Biology), including MTB antimicrobial resistance classification and DNALongBench benchmarking against HyenaDNA, Caduceus and NTv3.
